title: Taj Mahal
description: A masterpiece of Mughal architecture, the Taj Mahal transforms with the light—from luminous white by day to a serene golden glow after dark.

title: Amber Fort
description: Rising above Maota Lake, Amber Fort blends Rajput strength with Mughal artistry across grand courtyards, gateways, and mirrored halls.

title: Mysore Palace
description: This Indo-Saracenic royal residence pairs ornate domes and arches with a dazzling evening illumination that transforms its entire façade.

title: Virupaksha Temple
description: At the heart of Hampi, this living Shiva temple is crowned by a soaring gopuram whose carved tiers dominate the historic landscape.

title: Ajanta and Ellora Caves
description: These monumental rock-cut cave complexes preserve centuries of Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain sculpture, painting, and architectural ingenuity.

title: Brihadisvara Temple
description: Built by the Cholas, this granite masterpiece is celebrated for its monumental vimana, precise geometry, and exquisite stone carvings.

title: Konark Sun Temple
description: Designed as Surya's colossal stone chariot, the temple is famed for its sculpted wheels, horses, and intricate 13th-century craftsmanship.

title: Sanchi Stupa
description: One of India's oldest Buddhist monuments, the Great Stupa is encircled by richly carved gateways that narrate stories of faith and history.

title: Khajuraho Temples
description: The Chandela-era temples of Khajuraho are celebrated for soaring shikharas and remarkably detailed sandstone carvings.

title: Meenakshi Amman Temple
description: A living temple complex in Madurai, known for its towering, vividly sculpted gopurams and richly layered Dravidian artistry.

title: Ramappa Temple
description: The Kakatiya-era Ramappa Temple is admired for its intricate stonework, sculpted pillars, and distinctive floating-brick construction.

title: Hawa Mahal
description: Jaipur's Palace of Winds is an ornate rose-pink facade of jharokhas, latticework, and graceful Rajput-era symmetry.

title: Qutub Minar
description: The Qutub Minar rises above the historic complex in bands of red sandstone and marble, richly carved with inscriptions and ornament.

title: Humayun's Tomb
description: Set along a symmetrical Charbagh garden, Humayun's Tomb is a landmark of Mughal architecture in red sandstone and white marble.

title: Hampi Stone Chariot
description: The iconic Stone Chariot at Vittala Temple is a masterwork of Vijayanagara stone carving, framed by Hampi's granite landscape.

title: Himalayan Valleys
description: Remote Himalayan valleys bloom with wild alpine flowers.

title: Dal Lake Sunrise, Kashmir
description: Shikara boats glide through the still morning waters of Dal Lake as the Zabarwan mountains catch the first light of day.

title: Chembra Peak
description: A misty trek through the Western Ghats leads to Chembra Peak and its celebrated heart-shaped lake.

title: Coorg Coffee Estates
description: Shade-grown coffee plantations spread across Coorg's forested hills, scented with blossoms after the rains.

title: Khajjiar — Mini Switzerland
description: A saucer-shaped alpine meadow ringed by cedar forests gives Khajjiar its storybook mountain character.

title: Majuli Island
description: Majuli's riverine landscapes weave together wetlands, rice fields, village life, and shifting channels of the Brahmaputra.

title: Spiti Valley
description: A high-altitude cold desert of sculpted mountains, winding rivers, and remote settlements beneath vast Himalayan skies.

title: Sundarbans Mangroves
description: Tidal waterways thread through the world's largest mangrove forest where land, river, and sea continually meet.

title: Araku Valley
description: Terraced fields, wooded hills, and coffee gardens shape this tranquil valley in the Eastern Ghats.

title: Munnar Tea Gardens
description: Rolling emerald hills blanketed in tea bushes at 1,600 metres elevation.

title: Pangong Tso Lake
description: A brilliant high-altitude lake stretches between stark mountains, changing shades of blue with the sky and sunlight.

title: Tawang Valley
description: Snowy passes, mountain lakes, and prayer flags frame the dramatic landscapes surrounding Tawang.

title: Ziro Valley
description: Golden rice terraces and pine-covered hills surround the homeland of the Apatani community in Ziro Valley.

title: Bengal Tiger
description: Ranthambore National Park is one of India's best places to spot the Bengal tiger in the wild.

title: Elephants in Periyar
description: Wild elephants roaming through the dense green forests of South India.

title: Asiatic Lion of Gir
description: The last wild Asiatic lions roam the dry teak forests and grasslands of Gir, Gujarat.

title: One-horned Rhinoceros
description: Kaziranga's floodplain grasslands shelter the world's largest population of greater one-horned rhinoceroses.

title: Snow Leopard of Ladakh
description: A rare snow leopard blends into the high, rocky valleys of Ladakh, one of India's last great mountain wildernesses.
credit: T. R. Shankar Raman / Wikimedia Commons

title: Red Panda of Sikkim
description: Sikkim's state animal is a bamboo-loving Himalayan specialist with a quiet life in cool mountain forests.

title: Nilgiri Tahr
description: Sure-footed Nilgiri tahrs graze the montane grasslands and cliffs above Munnar in the Western Ghats.

title: Olive Ridley Turtles
description: Each season, Olive Ridley turtles return to Odisha's beaches in one of the world's great ocean migrations.

title: Great Indian Bustard
description: The tall, critically endangered Great Indian Bustard survives in the open grasslands of Rajasthan's Thar Desert.
credit: SVKMBFLY, edited by MPF / Wikimedia Commons

title: Ganges River Dolphin
description: India's national aquatic animal navigates the muddy currents of the Ganga by echolocation rather than sight.

title: Indian Wild Ass
description: Indian wild asses cross the salt flats and seasonal wetlands of Gujarat's Little Rann of Kutch.

title: Gaur of Bandipur
description: India's largest wild bovine moves through Bandipur's dry forests in powerful, close-knit herds.

title: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice and spiced meat are sealed together for the slow, aromatic dum cook that defines Hyderabad's signature biryani.

title: Kashmiri Rogan Josh
description: A slow-simmered Kashmiri curry of tender meat, fragrant spices, and the deep red colour of Kashmiri chilli.

title: Butter Chicken
description: Tandoori chicken meets a velvety tomato, butter, and cream gravy in one of North India's most beloved dishes.

title: Chole Bhature
description: Spiced chickpeas and airy, deep-fried bhature make this hearty North Indian breakfast a street-food classic.

title: Goan Fish Curry
description: Fresh fish swims in a tangy coconut-and-spice curry, traditionally served with hot Goan rice.

title: Pakhala Bhata
description: Fermented rice cooled with water and paired with crisp sides, Pakhala Bhata is Odisha's refreshing summer staple.

title: Litti Chokha
description: Roasted wheat-and-sattu litti is broken open beside smoky mashed vegetables and generous ghee.

title: Appam and Stew
description: Lacy, fermented rice pancakes cradle a gently spiced coconut-milk stew in this Kerala breakfast pairing.

title: Gujarati Dhokla
description: Soft, steamed savoury cakes are finished with mustard seeds, curry leaves, coriander, and a bright chutney.

title: Misal Pav
description: Sprouted-bean usal, fiery rassa, crunchy farsan, onions, and soft pav come together in Maharashtra's iconic snack.

title: Holi — Festival of Colours
description: Celebrated with intensity, Holi marks the arrival of spring with clouds of vibrant colour powder.

title: Diwali Lamps
description: During Diwali, millions of earthen lamps are lit, creating a vision of timeless devotion.

title: Durga Puja, Kolkata
description: Kolkata's Durga Puja transforms the city into the world's largest open-air art installation.

title: Baisakhi
description: Punjab's harvest festival and Sikh New Year bring village fairs, music, dancing, and gratitude for the new crop.

title: Christmas in India
description: Christmas in India fills churches, homes, and streets with midnight services, carols, lights, and open-hearted gatherings.

title: Dussehra
description: Dussehra celebrates the victory of good over evil through grand processions, performances, and the burning of effigies.

title: Eid-ul-Fitr
description: After Ramadan, Eid-ul-Fitr begins with prayers, new clothes, warm family visits, and tables of sweets and festive food.

title: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Colourful Ganesh idols, music-filled processions, and the final visarjan make Mumbai's Ganesh Chaturthi unforgettable.

title: Makar Sankranti
description: Makar Sankranti welcomes the sun's northward journey with harvest rituals, sesame sweets, and skies full of kites.

title: Navratri Garba
description: For nine nights, Navratri brings communities together for devotional garba and dandiya beneath bright festival lights.

title: Onam
description: Kerala's harvest homecoming is marked by flower carpets, boat races, traditional games, and the generous Onam sadya.

title: Raksha Bandhan
description: Raksha Bandhan celebrates the bond between siblings as sisters tie a rakhi and families share blessings and sweets.
